scope: Host-verifiable descriptor and arbitration contract for a future runtime feature; this artifact does not authorize runtime implementation.

event_queue.overflow: Drop the incoming event, increment a saturating diagnostic counter, and never overwrite an older queued event.

active_cues.layout: One persistent music-bed slot and three transient effect/jingle/system slots.
active_cues.music_admission: A new music cue replaces the music-bed slot according to the game-state transition; channel pre-emption never discards the bed's virtual timeline.
active_cues.transient_admission: Apply same-cue retrigger first, then use a free transient slot. If all three are occupied, replace the oldest preemptible transient having the lowest priority only when the incoming priority is strictly higher; otherwise drop the incoming event and increment the diagnostic counter.

descriptor.lookup: cue_id indexes an eight-byte table, allowing a three-bit left shift before adding the table base.

bits.0: exclusive: when set, allocation is all requested voices or silence

bits.1: noise uses tone-2 as its clock and must allocate tone-2 plus noise atomically
bits.0: degradable: preferred voices may be dropped down to the minimum

bits.7..6: resume mode: 0 continue timeline, 1 pause timeline, 2 restart stream, 3 terminate cue
bits.5: preemptible by a strictly higher-priority cue
bits.4: restore only at the next note boundary; zero restores on the next service tick

fields.name: voice_rank
fields.rule: Rank 0 is retained first and rank 3 is dropped first; equal ranks use logical voice number.

bits.7..6: parameter mode: 0 ignored, 1 signed transpose biased by 32, 2 variant, 3 intensity
bits.5..0: maximum accepted value for variant or intensity; zero for ignored or transpose

stream_commands.name: END
stream_commands.effect: Release every logical voice and remove the cue.

stream_commands.name: LOOP
stream_commands.effect: Return to the first command after descriptor activation.

stream_commands.name: SET_TONE
stream_commands.constraint: opcode low two bits select logical tone; period is little-endian 1 through 1023; attenuation is 0 through 15

stream_commands.name: SET_NOISE
stream_commands.constraint: control is the SN76489 three-bit noise control and attenuation is 0 through 15; rate selector 3 is invalid unless the descriptor declares atomic tone-2-clocked noise

invalid_stream_rule: Any undefined opcode, invalid logical voice, zero WAIT, period outside 1 through 1023, or attenuation outside 0 through 15 terminates the cue and increments a saturating diagnostic counter.

arbitration.retrigger_state: queue-one sets one saturating pending-retrigger bit on the active cue; END consumes that bit by restarting the cue once.
arbitration.suspension_boundary: Dropping an optional voice never pauses the cue. Falling below the minimum resource declaration applies the cue's continue, pause, restart, or terminate mode to the whole cue.
service_order: Apply END and release operations from the previous tick.
Drain queued events in FIFO order and apply each descriptor's retrigger rule.
Advance virtual cue streams whose suspension rule permits advancement.
Build required and optional logical-voice requests; treat tone-2-clocked noise as one atomic request.
Allocate by descending cue priority, required before optional, current owner before a new owner on an exact tie, then cue ID and logical voice number.
Reject an exclusive request unless all requested resources fit; reject a non-exclusive request unless its minimum resources fit.
Map retained tones to the lowest-numbered available physical tone while preserving an unchanged owner-to-channel mapping when possible.
Apply each displaced cue's continue, pause, restart, or terminate rule.
Diff the winning desired PSG state against the shadow state and emit only changed bytes.
arbitration.strict_preemption: A cue may displace a preemptible owner only when its priority is strictly higher. Equal priority never steals an owned channel.
arbitration.write_bound: A complete desired-state change is at most eleven SN76489 bytes: three tone period pairs, three tone volumes, one noise control, and one noise volume.
arbitration.music_default: Gameplay music is degradable, preemptible, and normally requests two preferred tones with one minimum tone. Its timeline continues while a voice is displaced, then the current note is restored on the next service tick.
arbitration.critical_default: Death, stage-complete, and award jingles request exclusive ownership and terminate or restart displaced gameplay music according to the separately reviewed cue descriptor.

current_anchor.finding: The treatment changes background code $D246 from flower $E5 to empty $FF and collected display $D344 from $FF to $01; the control leaves both values unchanged.
current_anchor.rom_finding: The flower-removal branch is $094A-$0955, the tile write is $094C, and MAME reports post-instruction PC $094D.
current_anchor.trace_finding: Treatment-only writes are chip-0 noise E6/F1 at frame 704, E4/F1 at frame 708, FF/FF at frame 712, and a final FF at frame 716. Both repeats are identical.

descriptor_after_proof.music_interaction: The measured cue uses fixed-clock noise only, so it coexists with all three music tones and does not pre-empt music. The matched control proves all non-noise writes remain unchanged through the cue window.
descriptor_after_proof.retrigger_interaction: A second flower event restarts the same active effect instead of allocating another instance; this remains a design rule because retrigger was not exercised by the isolation pair.

translation_artifacts.result: Eighteen descriptors and sixteen deduplicated command streams occupy 3478 projected bytes: 144 descriptor bytes and 3334 stream bytes.
translation_artifacts.level_start_reduction: Cue 6 is the only source cue above one-GMC capacity. Preliminary isolated rendering drops source stream 0 at ROM $1031; its RMS error is 2116.215091 versus 2842.038620, 2954.366530, and 2975.179268 for dropping streams 1, 2, and 3.
translation_artifacts.death_stop_rule: Cue 13 is priority 6, preemptible, and terminates when displaced. Cue 16 is priority 7 and atomically owns two tones for its attenuation-15 records, so the original silent channel-stop command terminates the death cue without allowing it to resume.
translation_artifacts.acceptance_limit: The generated data is deterministic and source-command exact after the declared cue-6 reduction. It remains a placement projection until linked runtime size, timing, arbitration, and physical-GMC checks pass.

open_gates: Measure descriptor, active-state, direct-page, cycle, and changed-write costs against the RSCH-001 limits after FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 integration.
Move the runtime contract into a separate Proposed feature ticket before changing assembly source.
